description: This file defines the 'ByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade' class, which implements the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface. It provides functionality to retrieve partial representations of 'things' by asking an actor within an Akka-based system, including methods for creating instances and retrieving partial 'things' with proper handling of signals and headers.

classes.name: ByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade
classes.description: A final class implementing SignalEnrichmentFacade to retrieve partial 'things' by querying an actor in an Akka system, with methods for creation and retrieval, including header management and signal handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade with specified actor selection and timeout.

methods.name: retrievePartialThing
methods.description: Retrieves a partial 'thing' identified by ThingId, using a signal, headers, and field selector, with special handling for delete signals and header management.

methods.name: extractPartialThing
methods.description: Private static method to extract a JsonObject from a RetrieveThingResponse, or propagate an exception if the object is not of the expected type.

methods.name: toThrowable
methods.description: Converts an object to a Throwable, wrapping non-Throwable objects in an IllegalStateException.
